patches.title: Drawer First for Clean
patches.principle: Start search by checking drawers then open surfaces before opening cabinets.
patches.when_to_apply: At the beginning of a clean task when the object location is unknown.

patches.title: Countertop Before Cabinets
patches.principle: If drawer search fails, examine all countertops and sinkbasins next before opening cabinets.
patches.when_to_apply: After checking drawers without finding the target object.

patches.title: Avoid Premature Pickup
patches.principle: Do not take an object unless you have a plan to transform and place it immediately.
patches.when_to_apply: When an object matching the target type is seen.
